full_prompt_en: A square storybook-style cartoon illustration shows a smiling trio and a small dog gathered around a pale standing stone on warm cream paper. The background is mostly blank, with a soft sage-green painted patch behind the group that fades into rough brush edges before reaching the page margins. A tall irregular rock rises near the center, its broken planes shaded in pale beige and warm gray. At left, a broad-shouldered red-haired man stands with hands in the pockets of an open dark charcoal jacket. A muted green shirt, olive shorts, and dark sandals make simple horizontal bands beneath his large friendly face. His spiky hair and rounded nose exaggerate the upward energy of his smile. Near the center, a smaller dark-haired figure sits on the stone. Short tousled black hair spreads wide around the head, while a brown one-piece garment and narrow legs make a compact silhouette. The figure faces forward with wide bright eyes and a slight grin. To the right, a blond figure sits higher on the rock with one leg crossed over the other. Pale hair is pinned up loosely, with a small stick or dark accent above it. A blue sleeveless outfit and thin dark sandals contrast with the warm skin tones; the open mouth and lifted brows give an animated happy expression. At the base of the rock, an orange-brown dog sits between the two seated figures, its ears, nose, and round eyes picked out with quick dark marks. Sparse dry grass and soft ochre ground shadow tie the feet, paws, and stone together along the bottom. The lighting is gentle and even, slightly warmer from the upper left, leaving small shadows under chins and around the stone's cracks. Loose painted texture appears in the green backdrop and earthy ground, while cleaner outlines keep the faces readable. The overall composition is informal and balanced, using varied heights, warm expressions, and a soft limited palette to give the group a relaxed, playful presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形故事书式卡通插画描绘三名微笑的人物和一只小狗，聚在暖奶油色纸面上的浅色立石旁。背景大多空白，人物身后是一片柔和鼠尾草绿的涂绘区域，以粗糙笔触边缘淡出，未触及纸张边沿。一块高而不规则的石头在中央附近升起，破碎石面以浅米色与暖灰色塑形。左侧，一名肩膀宽阔的红发男子站着，双手插在敞开的深炭灰外套口袋里。低饱和绿上衣、橄榄绿短裤和深色凉鞋在大而友好的脸下形成简洁横向色带。竖起的乱发和圆鼻子强化了笑容向上的活力。中央附近，一名较小的黑发人物坐在石头上。短而凌乱的黑发向两侧张开，棕色连身衣和细长双腿形成紧凑剪影。人物正面看着观者，眼睛明亮睁大，微微咧嘴笑。右侧，一名金发人物坐在较高的石头上，一条腿交叠在另一条腿上。浅发松松盘起，上面插着小木棍或深色饰物。蓝色无袖衣服和细带深色凉鞋对照暖肤色；张开的嘴和抬起的眉毛呈现活泼开心的表情。石块底部，一只橙棕色狗坐在两名坐姿人物之间，耳朵、鼻子和圆眼由迅疾的深色笔痕点出。稀疏的干草和柔和赭黄地影把脚、爪和石块连在底边。光线轻柔均匀，左上方稍暖，让下巴下和石缝周围保留小小阴影。绿色背景与土地呈现松动的绘画肌理，较干净的轮廓则使面孔清楚易读。整体构图随意而均衡，用不同身高、温暖表情和柔和受限的色调，让这一组形象显得放松活泼。
style_prompt_en: The storybook cartoon illustration mixes expressive drawn outlines with loose, softly brushed color. Proportions stretch and compress for personality: rounded facial masses, lively hair shapes, narrow limbs, and simple bodies remain immediately readable. Warm cream paper stays visible around a softly edged central color patch, giving the composition breathing room. Sage green, pale stone gray, ochre, muted blue, and small rusty orange accents form an earthy friendly palette. Light is mild and even, with modest shadows that seat the forms rather than dramatize them. Broad background strokes are rough and airy; cleaner lines and selective small highlights concentrate attention on the most expressive areas. Low clusters of texture and sparse fine marks finish the base without filling all the empty space. The overall effect is relaxed and humorous, with hand-painted warmth and clear silhouette rhythm carrying more weight than polished rendering.
style_prompt_zh: 这种故事书卡通插画把有表情的手绘轮廓与松散、柔软刷出的色彩混合。比例为性格表达而拉长或压缩：圆润的面部体块、活泼的发形、细长肢体与简化身体都能立即辨认。暖奶油色纸面在中央软边色斑周围保持可见，让构图有呼吸空间。鼠尾草绿、浅石灰、赭黄、低饱和蓝与少量锈橙色重音组成亲切的土地色调。光线温和均匀，适度阴影让形体落稳，而非制造戏剧效果。宽阔背景笔痕粗糙轻盈；更干净的线条和选择性小亮部把注意力集中到最具表情的区域。底部的低矮肌理聚簇和稀疏细痕完成画面，却没有填满所有空白。整体效果轻松幽默，手绘暖意和清晰剪影节奏比精致渲染承担更多视觉重量。
theme_en: A smiling cartoon trio and a small dog gathered around a pale stone
theme_zh: 三名微笑的卡通人物和一只小狗围在浅色石块旁
name: The Flintstones
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
